name: Online
description: The modem programs: TERM, a terminal for the modem port (dial the bulletin board or a telnet host, XMODEM); IRC, an IRC client; GOPHER, a Gopher client (menus, texts, searches, the way back, save to a file); MUD, a client for text worlds; FINGER, who is on a host or what someone's plan says; NETTIME, the time from a clock on the net. Each with its directory where it has one (TERM.DIR, IRC.DIR, GOPHER.DIR, MUD.DIR). Put it in B:, then B: and the program.
credit: Costin Stroie; MIT licence. Source: TERM and IRC github.com/cstroie/dialtone (system/dialtone); GOPHER, MUD, FINGER, NETTIME system/net.
